sketch.label_rule: rank of the WNID folder in sorted ImageNet-1k

sketch_near_duplicates.note: heuristic: thumbnails of the 224 px crops; a centre crop of a flipped image differs from the flip of the centre crop by at most one pixel column

notes: ImageNet-Sketch pads some classes with flipped and rotated copies of other images (configs/data/shift_sets.yaml); an exactly invariant model scores such a flipped pair alike, so Sketch numbers are reported with this caveat and also without one image of each detected near-duplicate pair
the probe of each model is the tier2_linear ImageNet probe trained on the bank; nothing is fitted on validation or on the shifted sets
